title: iPhone free for 10 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 10 min (since 11:39Z; the lease of arch-compositor-morph ran out). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: end-morph (owner fix-end-morph; its next step names the phone (unmarked)).
What unblocks it: the next of fix-end-morph takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).

False alarm: the job waiting for the iPhone (the shimmer check P-162) may start only after its Mac and Simulator checks pass; I marked that on the board at 11:51Z.

- Cause: fix-end-morph's board row named the phone as its next step without saying it was not ready yet.
- The idle watch now shows no ready work, so the alarm closes by itself when the phone is taken.

What you need to do: nothing; the phone is free if you want to try v14.
